requested_items.objective: Measure hierarchy-matched routed node-5 router activity power for the complete Llama7B Phase 2 replay.

expected_result.reason: The result must preserve portable equivalence, physical lineage, annotation coverage, and energy evidence while raw VCD/ODB/SPEF remain evaluator-local.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require complete cycle-level RTL/performance replay equivalence, isolated routed variants, explicit retimestamping of the unchanged cycle sequence to the routed target clock, direct VCD annotation, at least 95 percent sequential-register sidecar coverage, finite power, and timing-feasible best-point selection. Do not promote as aggregate mesh, endpoint/SRAM, or HBM/DRAM energy.
